latest_release.name: Piik v2.6.1
latest_release.body:
**Piik, now in your pocket.**

Piik App supports Android screen sharing, with touch controls for a friend's computer.

**手机，也能开播。**

Piik App 支持 Android 屏幕分享，也能用手机控制朋友的电脑。

### English

This maintenance update improves App authorization, capture-source switching and controls on smaller screens.

- Fix commentary controls remaining busy after switching from Browser capture to the App.
- Let App site approval recover from a stalled save, keeping access already granted.
- Preserve numeric-input focus when the mobile keyboard resizes the page, and provide increase/decrease buttons. Keep interaction windows at their remembered position after rapid hide/show actions.
- Give nicknames readable space on smaller screens, while retaining edit controls and accessible labels. Keep launcher diagnostics inside the shared Help menu.
- Make room-connection help easier to find, and clarify Safari screen-sharing and sound support.
- Complete package mirroring after a later CI publication step fails, and verify managed-service deployments against the intended source revision.

This maintenance update preserves the established 2.x room, invitation, media,
App-control and storage contracts. Refresh a site's open pages after it is
updated. App-local users need the updated App bundle to receive its included
Web fixes. Existing compatible 2.x App/site workflows remain supported.

### 中文

本次维护更新改善 App 授权、切换分享源和小屏操作。

- 修复浏览器切换为 App 采集后，分享麦克风控制一直处于忙碌状态的问题。
- App 站点授权不再因保存卡住而一直转圈；可以重试，已批准的授权也会保留。
- 手机键盘改变页面尺寸时保留数字输入焦点，并提供增减按钮；互动窗口快速隐藏再打开后保留记忆位置。
- 小屏上为昵称保留可读空间，同时保留编辑入口与无障碍名称；启动页诊断统一收进帮助菜单。
- 更容易找到房间连接问题的排查入口，并说明 Safari 屏幕分享与声音的支持情况。
- 发布流程后续步骤失败时，仍可补全已经发布的程序包镜像；部署核验明确比对预期源码版本。

本维护更新保留既有 2.x 房间、邀请、媒体、App 控制与存储契约。
站点更新后请刷新已打开的网页；App 本地使用者需更新程序包，才能使用其中的新网页修复。
已有兼容的 2.x App／站点使用方式继续支持。

---

[Full changelog / 完整变更](https://github.com/TNTcraftHIM/Piik/compare/v2.6.0...07e37c722869955a183aee523f45fcbc7119964d)

detail.readme_excerpt:
Piik

Share the good stuff.
Private screen sharing for you and up to 20 friends.

Website · Download · AtomGit mirror · Use online · Documentation

English · 简体中文

Piik is a free, open-source screen sharing tool for private live streams with friends: games, movie nights, drawings and photos. Choose what to share and send an invitation. Your friends watch in their browsers. You can also self-host Piik on your own server.
A little room · Show / hide animation

[Features](#features) · [Get started](#get-started) · [Self-hosting](#self-hosting) · [Contributing](#contributing) ## Features - **Watch without installing.** Friends join by invitation in a desktop or mobile browser. - **Share from Piik App or an existing Piik site.** Choose a screen, window, browser tab or camera; available sources and audio depend on the platform. - **Direct connections first.** Media travels between participants where possible (P2P). A self-hosted server can provide automatic media forwarding (SFU) as a fallback. - **Rooms you control.** Invitations, room codes and optional room passwords, for one host and up to 20 viewers. - **Talk and chat together.** Join room voice, send messages and reactions, or enable on-screen chat. - **Hand control to friends.** Share an App window or screen and approve remote control. Allow friends to play together with shared keyboard/mouse or supported gamepads; take control back at any time. [Setup guide](./docs/guide/remote-control.md). - **Flexible viewing.** Light and dark themes, playback controls, picture-in-picture and a connection topology view. - **One program to host a site.** Web UI, room management and optional media forwarding are packaged together.
